_comment: Contract registry for StonkFlyRH. Copy to tokens.json and fill in.
No address is shipped in this repository. Look each one up yourself on the
Robinhood Chain explorer and on the Uniswap deployments page, then run
`python -m stonkflyrh chain verify` — it refuses any address that holds no
code, a router and quoter that disagree about their factory, a token whose
on-chain symbol or decimals differ from what you wrote here, and any pair
with no pool at the configured fee tier.
Dollar limits need an ETH/USD reference: 'eth_usd_feed' is a Chainlink
aggregator (preferred); 'stable' prices a WETH probe through a stablecoin
pool via the same quoter instead. USDG is the chain's settlement stablecoin.
pool_fee is the Uniswap v3 tier in hundredths of a bip: 500, 3000 or 10000.
A Pons launch graduates into a 1% pool with permanently locked liquidity.
